name: Wolf Saw Howl.aif
description:
I was at Guitar Center the other day & they had an Akai Timbre Wolf set up. I was noodling around on it & noticed how well it was constructed. The chassis is metal. All of the Knobs & Buttons are sturdy as hell. The Pitch Bend is solid & snaps back nicely. Even the keys feel good! Not quite "SemiWeighted", but damn close! 

 Of course the filter situation is a bit weird & the lack of ADSRs/LFOs is a bit of a pain in the ass... but these limitations can be kind of inspiring in a way. 

 Then I noticed that it was on sale for $199! Of course I bought it :P 

 Here's some recordings of it's VCOs/VCF ( with & without Resonance ), as well as the "Howl Circuit". Each of the 4 VCOs is switchable between Square & Sawtooth.

This is uses the classic thunderclap by a Freesound user whose name I can't remember but will ad when I do remember, some more classic moaning wind by me, a retro wolf howl performed by yours truly with added reverb on top.  Use freely and enjoy.
